propositions: Project-declared code-review criteria are dropped at criterion-id resolver, Round-A fan-in, Pass-3 routing, eval/calibration surface, and CLI admission in the four-pass review system

The eight decomposed child tickets repair each drop-point seam across criterion-id resolution, batch fan-in attribution, repository-effective routing, eval admission, CLI admission, documentation, eval corpus, and live dogfooding
An active project code-review criterion must run once in Round A, retain logical criteria id and physical reviewer_id, and use repository-effective Pass-3 routing
The runtime extension contract and project criterion API must be documented and proven by end-to-end unit tests spanning resolver, fan-in, routing, and eval admission
Project criterion evaluation and CLI must admit active code-review-only criteria while rejecting inactive or ambiguous project ids, with balanced corpus and prompt present
The epic supersedes three prior tickets (jira-reb-1001, 2c14-fa5f-1228-4e02, 8a4b-e8b6-1bf9-48d8) and proves the deployed Gerrit review bot extension contract via advisory-only live reviews
